summary: Patrick Industries filed an 8-K updating its pending acquisition of LCI Industries under a June 30, 2026 merger agreement, structured as a forward merger of Patrick's subsidiary into LCI followed by a downstream merger into an Indiana LLC. On August 5, 2026 both parties filed HSR notifications; Patrick voluntarily withdrew its filing on September 4, 2026 and refiled September 9, 2026, restarting the 30-day antitrust waiting period with the FTC and DOJ. The transaction remains subject to HSR clearance, a joint proxy statement/prospectus on Form S-4, and other closing conditions. Watch the new HSR clock, potential second requests, and any revised exchange ratio or financing terms disclosed in the S-4.
